x4 NVMe™ SSD • PCIe Gen5 x4 interface with up to 10300MB/s read speeds. • Available in 1TB and 2TB variants for flexible storage needs. • Low-power PCIe Gen 5 controller for energy efficiency. • Optimized for gamers, content creators, and AI users seeking speed. • Compact M.2 2280 form factor fits snugly in laptops and PCs. • No heatsink design, great for tight spaces. • NVMe 2.0 support for lower latency and high performance. • 3D NAND technology enables robust, space-efficient storage. • 7th generation LDPC error correction enhances data integrity. • Supports SLC caching for improved read/write speeds and performance. • Compatible with RAID setups for data redundancy. • Easy installation in modern desktops and laptops.
